107:     /// @dev Returns an array of all the values in the tree in ascending sorted order.
108:     /// WARNING! This function can exhaust the block gas limit if the tree is big.
109:     /// It is intended for usage in off-chain view functions.
110:     function values(Tree storage tree) internal view returns (uint256[] memory result) {
111:         uint256 nodes = _nodes(tree);
112:         /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
113:         assembly {
114:             function visit(current_) {
115:                 if iszero(current_) { leave } // If the current node is null, leave.
116:                 current_ := or(mload(0x00), current_) // Current node's storage slot.
117:                 let packed_ := sload(current_)
118:                 visit(and(packed_, _BITMASK_KEY)) // Visit left child.
119:                 let value_ := shr(_BITPOS_PACKED_VALUE, packed_) // Current value.
120:                 if iszero(value_) { value_ := sload(or(current_, _BIT_FULL_VALUE_SLOT)) }
121:                 mstore(mload(0x20), value_) // Append the value to `results`.
122:                 mstore(0x20, add(0x20, mload(0x20))) // Advance the offset into `results`.
123:                 visit(and(shr(_BITPOS_RIGHT, packed_), _BITMASK_KEY)) // Visit right child.
124:             }
125:             result := mload(0x40)
126:             let rootPacked := sload(nodes)
127:             mstore(result, and(rootPacked, _BITMASK_KEY)) // Length of `result`.
128:             mstore(0x00, nodes) // Cache the nodes pointer in scratch space.
129:             mstore(0x20, add(result, 0x20)) // Cache the offset into `results` in scratch space.
130:             mstore(0x40, add(mload(0x20), shl(5, mload(result)))) // Allocate memory.
131:             visit(shr(128, rootPacked)) // Start the tree traversal from the root node.
132:         }
133:     }

142:     /// @dev Returns a pointer to the nearest value to `x`.
143:     /// In a tie-breaker, the returned pointer will point to the smaller value.
144:     /// If the tree is empty, the returned pointer will be empty.
145:     function nearest(Tree storage tree, uint256 x) internal view returns (bytes32 result) {
146:         (uint256 nodes, uint256 cursor, uint256 key) = _find(tree, x);
147:         unchecked {
148:             if (cursor == uint256(0)) return result; // Nothing found -- empty tree.
149:             if (key != uint256(0)) return _pack(nodes, key); // Exact match.
150:             bytes32 a = _pack(nodes, cursor);
151:             uint256 aValue = value(a);
152:             bytes32 b = x < aValue ? prev(a) : next(a);
153:             if (b == bytes32(0)) return a; // Only node found.
154:             uint256 bValue = value(b);
155:             uint256 aDist = x < aValue ? aValue - x : x - aValue;
156:             uint256 bDist = x < bValue ? bValue - x : x - bValue;
157:             return (aDist == bDist ? aValue < bValue : aDist < bDist) ? a : b;
158:         }

31:     /// @dev Reserves at least `minimum` amount of contiguous memory.
32:     function reserve(DynamicBuffer memory buffer, uint256 minimum)
33:         internal
34:         pure
35:         returns (DynamicBuffer memory result)
36:     {
37:         _deallocate(result);
38:         result = buffer;
39:         uint256 n = buffer.data.length;
40:         if (minimum > n) {
41:             uint256 i = 0x40;
42:             do {} while ((i <<= 1) < minimum);
43:             bytes memory data;
44:             /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
45:             assembly {
46:                 data := 0x01
47:                 mstore(data, sub(i, n))
48:             }
49:             result = p(result, data);
50:         }
51:     }

73:     /// @dev Appends `data` to `buffer`.
74:     function p(DynamicBuffer memory buffer, bytes memory data)
75:         internal
76:         pure
77:         returns (DynamicBuffer memory result)
78:     {
79:         _deallocate(result);
80:         result = buffer;
81:         if (data.length == uint256(0)) return result;
82:         /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
83:         assembly {
84:             let w := not(0x1f)
85:             let bufData := mload(buffer)
86:             let bufDataLen := mload(bufData)
87:             let newBufDataLen := add(mload(data), bufDataLen)
88:             // Some random prime number to multiply `cap`, so that
89:             // we know that the `cap` is for a dynamic buffer.
90:             // Selected to be larger than any memory pointer realistically.
91:             let prime := 1621250193422201
92:             let cap := mload(add(bufData, w)) // `mload(sub(bufData, 0x20))`.
93:             // Extract `cap`, initializing it to zero if it is not a multiple of `prime`.
94:             cap := mul(div(cap, prime), iszero(mod(cap, prime)))
95: 
96:             // Expand / Reallocate memory if required.
97:             // Note that we need to allocate an extra word for the length, and
98:             // and another extra word as a safety word (giving a total of 0x40 bytes).
99:             // Without the safety word, the backwards copying can cause a buffer overflow.
100:             for {} iszero(lt(newBufDataLen, cap)) {} {
101:                 // Approximately more than double the capacity to ensure more than enough space.
102:                 let newCap := and(add(cap, add(or(cap, newBufDataLen), 0x20)), w)
103:                 // If the memory is contiguous, we can simply expand it.
104:                 if iszero(or(xor(mload(0x40), add(bufData, add(0x40, cap))), eq(bufData, 0x60))) {
105:                     // Store `cap * prime` in the word before the length.
106:                     mstore(add(bufData, w), mul(prime, newCap))
107:                     mstore(0x40, add(bufData, add(0x40, newCap))) // Expand the memory allocation.
108:                     break
109:                 }
110:                 // Set the `newBufData` to point to the word after `cap`.
111:                 let newBufData := add(mload(0x40), 0x20)
112:                 mstore(0x40, add(newBufData, add(0x40, newCap))) // Reallocate the memory.
113:                 mstore(buffer, newBufData) // Store the `newBufData`.
114:                 // Copy `bufData` one word at a time, backwards.
115:                 for { let o := and(add(bufDataLen, 0x20), w) } 1 {} {
116:                     mstore(add(newBufData, o), mload(add(bufData, o)))
117:                     o := add(o, w) // `sub(o, 0x20)`.
118:                     if iszero(o) { break }
119:                 }
120:                 // Store `cap * prime` in the word before the length.
121:                 mstore(add(newBufData, w), mul(prime, newCap))
122:                 bufData := newBufData // Assign `newBufData` to `bufData`.
123:                 break
124:             }
125:             // If it's a reserve operation, set the variables to skip the appending.
126:             if eq(data, 0x01) {
127:                 mstore(data, 0x00)
128:                 newBufDataLen := bufDataLen
129:             }
130:             // Copy `data` one word at a time, backwards.
131:             for { let o := and(add(mload(data), 0x20), w) } 1 {} {
132:                 mstore(add(add(bufData, bufDataLen), o), mload(add(data, o)))
133:                 o := add(o, w) // `sub(o, 0x20)`.
134:                 if iszero(o) { break }
135:             }
136:             mstore(add(add(bufData, 0x20), newBufDataLen), 0) // Zeroize the word after the buffer.
137:             mstore(bufData, newBufDataLen) // Store the length.
138:         }
139:     }

533:                 sstore(or(nodes_, key_), and(sload(or(nodes_, key_)), not(BR)))

536:             function replaceParent(nodes_, parent_, a_, b_) {

540:                 }

613:                 let cursorValue_ := shr(_BITPOS_PACKED_VALUE, sload(or(nodes_, cursor_)))

653:             mstore(0x00, codesize()) // Zeroize the first 0x10 bytes.

679:     /// @dev Finds `x` in `tree`. The `key` will be zero if `x` is not found.

681:         private
682:         view
683:         returns (uint256 nodes, uint256 cursor, uint256 key)

685:         if (x == uint256(0)) _revert(0xc94f1877); // `ValueIsEmpty()`.
686:         /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly

688:             mstore(0x20, tree.slot)
689:             mstore(0x00, _NODES_SLOT_SEED)
690:             nodes := shl(_NODES_SLOT_SHIFT, keccak256(0x00, 0x40))
691:             // Layout scratch space so that `mload(0x00) == 0`, `mload(0x01) == _BITPOS_RIGHT`.
692:             mstore(0x01, _BITPOS_RIGHT) // `_BITPOS_RIGHT` is 31.
693:             for { let probe := shr(128, sload(nodes)) } probe {} {

697:                 if iszero(nodeValue) {
698:                     nodeValue := sload(or(or(nodes, probe), _BIT_FULL_VALUE_SLOT))
699:                 }
700:                 if eq(nodeValue, x) {
701:                     key := cursor
702:                     break
703:                 }
704:                 probe := and(shr(mload(gt(x, nodeValue)), nodePacked), _BITMASK_KEY)
705:             }
706:         }
707:     }

107:     /// @dev Returns an array of all the values in the tree in ascending sorted order.
108:     /// WARNING! This function can exhaust the block gas limit if the tree is big.
109:     /// It is intended for usage in off-chain view functions.
110:     function values(Tree storage tree) internal view returns (uint256[] memory result) {
111:         uint256 nodes = _nodes(tree);
112:         /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
113:         assembly {
114:             function visit(current_) {
115:                 if iszero(current_) { leave } // If the current node is null, leave.
116:                 current_ := or(mload(0x00), current_) // Current node's storage slot.
117:                 let packed_ := sload(current_)
118:                 visit(and(packed_, _BITMASK_KEY)) // Visit left child.
119:                 let value_ := shr(_BITPOS_PACKED_VALUE, packed_) // Current value.
120:                 if iszero(value_) { value_ := sload(or(current_, _BIT_FULL_VALUE_SLOT)) }
121:                 mstore(mload(0x20), value_) // Append the value to `results`.
122:                 mstore(0x20, add(0x20, mload(0x20))) // Advance the offset into `results`.
123:                 visit(and(shr(_BITPOS_RIGHT, packed_), _BITMASK_KEY)) // Visit right child.
124:             }
125:             result := mload(0x40)
126:             let rootPacked := sload(nodes)
127:             mstore(result, and(rootPacked, _BITMASK_KEY)) // Length of `result`.
128:             mstore(0x00, nodes) // Cache the nodes pointer in scratch space.
129:             mstore(0x20, add(result, 0x20)) // Cache the offset into `results` in scratch space.
130:             mstore(0x40, add(mload(0x20), shl(5, mload(result)))) // Allocate memory.
131:             visit(shr(128, rootPacked)) // Start the tree traversal from the root node.
132:         }
133:     }

142:     /// @dev Returns a pointer to the nearest value to `x`.
143:     /// In a tie-breaker, the returned pointer will point to the smaller value.
144:     /// If the tree is empty, the returned pointer will be empty.
145:     function nearest(Tree storage tree, uint256 x) internal view returns (bytes32 result) {
146:         (uint256 nodes, uint256 cursor, uint256 key) = _find(tree, x);
147:         unchecked {
148:             if (cursor == uint256(0)) return result; // Nothing found -- empty tree.
149:             if (key != uint256(0)) return _pack(nodes, key); // Exact match.
150:             bytes32 a = _pack(nodes, cursor);
151:             uint256 aValue = value(a);
152:             bytes32 b = x < aValue ? prev(a) : next(a);
153:             if (b == bytes32(0)) return a; // Only node found.
154:             uint256 bValue = value(b);
155:             uint256 aDist = x < aValue ? aValue - x : x - aValue;
156:             uint256 bDist = x < bValue ? bValue - x : x - bValue;
157:             return (aDist == bDist ? aValue < bValue : aDist < bDist) ? a : b;
158:         }
159:     }

282:     function _unpack(bytes32 ptr) private pure returns (uint256 nodes, uint256 key) {
283:         /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly

285:             nodes := shl(_NODES_SLOT_SHIFT, shr(_NODES_SLOT_SHIFT, ptr))

291:     function _pack(uint256 nodes, uint256 key) private pure returns (bytes32 result) {
292:         /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly

294:             result := mul(or(nodes, key), iszero(iszero(key)))

298:     /// @dev Returns the pointer to either end of the tree.
299:     function _end(Tree storage tree, uint256 L) private view returns (bytes32 result) {
300:         uint256 nodes = _nodes(tree);
301:         /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
302:         assembly {
303:             result := shr(128, sload(nodes))
304:             if result {
305:                 for {} 1 {} {
306:                     let packed := sload(or(nodes, result))
307:                     let left := and(shr(L, packed), _BITMASK_KEY)
308:                     if iszero(left) { break }
309:                     result := left
310:                 }
311:             }
312:         }
313:         result = _pack(nodes, uint256(result));
314:     }

316:     /// @dev Step the pointer `ptr` forwards or backwards.
317:     function _step(bytes32 ptr, uint256 L, uint256 R) private view returns (bytes32 result) {
318:         if (ptr == bytes32(0)) return ptr;
319:         (uint256 nodes, uint256 target) = _unpack(ptr);
320:         /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
321:         assembly {
322:             let packed := sload(ptr)
323:             for { result := and(shr(R, packed), _BITMASK_KEY) } 1 {} {
324:                 if iszero(result) {
325:                     result := and(shr(_BITPOS_PARENT, packed), _BITMASK_KEY)
326:                     for {} 1 {} {
327:                         if iszero(result) { break }
328:                         packed := sload(or(nodes, result))
329:                         if iszero(eq(target, and(shr(R, packed), _BITMASK_KEY))) { break }
330:                         target := result
331:                         result := and(shr(_BITPOS_PARENT, packed), _BITMASK_KEY)
332:                     }
333:                     break
334:                 }
335:                 for {} 1 {} {
336:                     packed := sload(or(nodes, result))
337:                     let left := and(shr(L, packed), _BITMASK_KEY)
338:                     if iszero(left) { break }
339:                     result := left
340:                 }
341:                 break
342:             }
343:         }
344:         result = _pack(nodes, uint256(result));
345:     }

347:     /// @dev Inserts or delete the value `x` from the tree.
348:     function _update(uint256 nodes, uint256 cursor, uint256 key, uint256 x, uint256 mode)
349:         private
350:         returns (uint256 err)
351:     {
352:         /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
353:         assembly {
354:             function getKey(packed_, bitpos_) -> index_ {
355:                 index_ := and(_BITMASK_KEY, shr(bitpos_, packed_))
356:             }
357: 
358:             function setKey(packed_, bitpos_, key_) -> result_ {
359:                 result_ := or(and(not(shl(bitpos_, _BITMASK_KEY)), packed_), shl(bitpos_, key_))
360:             }
361: 
362:             function rotate(nodes_, key_, L, R) {
363:                 let packed_ := sload(or(nodes_, key_))
364:                 let cursor_ := getKey(packed_, R)
365:                 let parent_ := getKey(packed_, _BITPOS_PARENT)
366:                 let cursorPacked_ := sload(or(nodes_, cursor_))
367:                 let cursorLeft_ := getKey(cursorPacked_, L)
368: 
369:                 if cursorLeft_ {
370:                     let s_ := or(nodes_, cursorLeft_)
371:                     sstore(s_, setKey(sload(s_), _BITPOS_PARENT, key_))
372:                 }
373: 
374:                 for {} 1 {} {
375:                     if iszero(parent_) {
376:                         mstore(0x00, cursor_)
377:                         break
378:                     }
379:                     let s_ := or(nodes_, parent_)
380:                     let parentPacked_ := sload(s_)
381:                     if eq(key_, getKey(parentPacked_, L)) {
382:                         sstore(s_, setKey(parentPacked_, L, cursor_))

384:                     }
385:                     sstore(s_, setKey(parentPacked_, R, cursor_))
386:                     break
387:                 }
388:                 packed_ := setKey(packed_, R, cursorLeft_)
389:                 sstore(or(nodes_, key_), setKey(packed_, _BITPOS_PARENT, cursor_))
390:                 cursorPacked_ := setKey(cursorPacked_, _BITPOS_PARENT, parent_)
391:                 sstore(or(nodes_, cursor_), setKey(cursorPacked_, L, key_))
392:             }

395:                 if key_ {

397:                     leave
398:                 }

400:                 let totalNodes_ := add(shr(128, mload(0x20)), 1)
401:                 if gt(totalNodes_, _BITMASK_KEY) {

403:                     leave
404:                 }

406:                 mstore(0x20, shl(128, totalNodes_))

408:                 {
409:                     let packed_ := or(_BITMASK_RED, shl(_BITPOS_PARENT, cursor_))

412:                     for {} 1 {} {

435:                         sstore(s_, setKey(cPacked_, _BITPOS_LEFT, totalNodes_))

440:                 // Insert fixup workflow:
441: 
442:                 key_ := totalNodes_
443:                 let BR := _BITMASK_RED
444:                 for {} iszero(eq(key_, mload(0x00))) {} {
445:                     let packed_ := sload(or(nodes_, key_))

450:                     let grandParent_ := getKey(parentPacked_, _BITPOS_PARENT)

453:                     let R := mul(eq(parent_, getKey(grandParentPacked_, 0)), _BITPOS_RIGHT)

456:                     let c_ := getKey(grandParentPacked_, R)

533:                 sstore(or(nodes_, key_), and(sload(or(nodes_, key_)), not(BR)))
